'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Dirk Friedrichs LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Dirk Friedrichs]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Dirk Friedrichs]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|We'll Handle This]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
